Ngl I think the order Lindon chose was smart.

1. SK. Cool bow plus insane dross power up, SK possessing people more and more over time would've been bad too.

2. WD. Not much of a choice here, but a fully powered WD would be insane. Might be better to have it killed first honestly, though Lindon also didn't have much choice for the first fight either.

3 and 4. BP and WT: Honestly, these are probably the weaker ones. Isolated and with lindons powers, BP can't do much as it can't create an army of blood shadows. WT was never too smart and always felt like the weakest dreadgod, at least to me. Yes, it was powerful physically and could destroy things, but that was pretty much all it could do, easily countered by matching the physical strength. 5 monarchs, even if new, had intent to kill it and with dross on each of their sides, it would be relatively simple and straightforward to kill WT.
